name: Underworld Dragon, Wyrmling
body:
This serpentine dragon has skin the color of deep volcanic rock, enormous claws, and jagged, stonelike horns and scales.

Wyrmling Underworld Dragon
CR 3

XP 800
LE Tiny dragon (fire)
Init +6; Senses dragon senses; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +4 natural, +2 size)
hp 30 (4d12+4)
Fort +5, Ref +6, Will +4 Immune fire, paralysis, sleep
Weaknesses vulnerability to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., burrow 30 ft., fly 100 ft. (average)
Melee bite +8 (1d4+1), 2 claws +7 (1d3+1)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft. (5 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks adamantine claws, breath weapon (30-ft. line, 2d6 fire damage, DC 13)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 14, Con 13, Int 10, Wis 11, Cha 10
Base Atk +4; CMB +4; CMD 15 (+19 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Initiative, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Appraise +7, Climb +8, Fly +6, Intimidate +7, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +7, Perception +7, Stealth +17
Languages Common, Draconic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Adamantine Claws (Ex)

The claws of an underworld dragon are made of adamantine, and have the qualities of a weapon made from that material.

ECOLOGY

Environment any underground
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Underworld dragons, also called futsanglungs, are calculating, greedy creatures that carve great labyrinthine tunnels beneath the world, defending their hidden treasures. Preferring the earth to the heavens, they channel the fires of the world’s core within their twisting, stonelike bodies and through flaming breath hot enough to turn granite into slag.
